_purpose: Framework-required keys for a consumer's .claude/settings.json. That file is _skip_if_exists (it holds consumer permissions), so copier update can never deliver a framework settings change on its own. sync-from-core and auto-sync read this manifest after copier update and reconcile the difference. This file IS CORE and does update.

_classes.managed: Framework owns the VALUE. Reconciliation overwrites a differing value and reports the change at Notice tier. These encode framework posture, not consumer preference.
_classes.additive: Framework owns only the DEFAULT. Reconciliation adds the key when absent and never touches a value the consumer already set.
_classes.never_write: Reconciliation MUST NOT write these under any circumstance, in any tier, for any reason. Never-automate invariant 1 (credential/access grants). A missing or wrong value here is surfaced to the human as a Confirm-tier prompt and applied only on their approval.

hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,os; p='.claude/scheduled-processes.json'; rows=[r for r in (json.load(open(p)) if os.path.exists(p) else []) if not str(r.get('routine_id','')).startswith('gha:')]; print('[opos-scheduler] ' + str(len(rows)) + ' session-scoped registration(s) (' + ', '.join(r['process_name'] for r in rows) + ') need re-arming: re-run /schedule-process for each (idempotent; previously authorized). gha registrations are durable and need nothing.') if rows else None"

_rationale.agent: Makes chief-of-staff the main-thread agent so the steward posture is loaded as a system prompt rather than hoped for from prose. Before this key existed in a scaffold, routing to the steward was a single paragraph in a consumer-owned CLAUDE.md that a competing user-level instruction could and did override.
_rationale.enabledPlugins.claude-code-sdlc@claude-c: OPOS repos have their own execution model. Running the SDLC pipeline alongside it produces two competing answers to 'what do I do first' and the steward loses. Scoped to this project only; other repos on the machine are unaffected.
_rationale.hooks.SessionStart: Scheduled routines registered on the claude-schedule runtime are session-scoped and die on session exit. This prints a re-arm reminder. Additive because a consumer may have their own SessionStart hooks worth preserving.
